reviewType: Independent read-only source recheck of the AC04 persistence fixes and parent settlement follow-up. This is not a gameplay, Studio, cloud, build, or executed-test review.
constraintsObserved: Read AGENTS.md and the original review before inspecting the fixes.
Did not build, compile, run tests, launch Studio, use Rojo, invoke cloud APIs, publish, upload, commit, or push.
Did not edit source or docs/human; the only write is this review JSON.
Treated build/skybreak.rbxlx as frozen and verified by read-only hash only: 822e74bd19bb0d0e890e0240fc37e4e2f9eae0e4e16e49cbc1aa47976b41cdf7.

verdict.summary: No reproducible remaining source defect was found in the reviewed persistence, completion, settlement, service wiring, or AC04-only checker fixes. The three prior findings and the completion/removal ordering concern are addressed in source. This is a bounded approval of the source changes, not perfect certification or runtime proof.
verdict.disposition: Source recheck passes with explicit unverified runtime, service-integration, cloud, and release-cutover limits.

evidence: src/shared/AC04Progress.ts:28-64 accepts only absence or a complete, losslessly normalizable v1 profile: exactly four slots, strict fields, valid aircraft/timestamps, dense unique known chapters, and valid completed mission records.
src/shared/AC04Progress.ts:45-48 accepts canonical numeric mission keys and canonical DataStore string keys such as "1", while rejecting ambiguous numeric/string duplicates and noncanonical strings.
src/shared/AC04Progress.ts:98-100 asserts strict readability before normalization/merge, so malformed existing data is not converted to a blank profile for persistence.
src/server/AC04Persistence.ts:19-24 refuses a malformed value returned by GetAsync without installing a blank loaded profile.

src/server/AC04Persistence.ts:31-38 snapshots before the yielding update and applies the same guarded merge inside the UpdateAsync transform. A concurrently malformed cloud value throws before replacement, restores dirty=true, and remains retryable.
priorFindingRechecks.assessment: The destructive malformed-record path from the original review is closed. Canonical v1 records and canonical DataStore string mission keys remain accepted.

priorFindingRechecks.status: addressed in source with bounded checker scope
evidence: The obsolete tools/build-relay-assets.py and the four named legacy mission mesh inputs are deleted from the working tree.

tools/check-ac04-only.ts:22-27 scans runtime source, executable tools, assets, package.json, and project files; lines 29-45 additionally resolve and inspect actual project mappings while refusing package escapes and excluding vendor mappings.
tools/check-ac04-only.ts:13 and 33 reject the four retired asset/generator names, including the otherwise generic grainsilo mission export, by both discovered and mapped path.
tools/check-ac04-only.ts:16-19 narrowly rewrites only the exact historical usage phrase in two retained provenance/checklist files. It does not provide a general content bypass.
tools/tests/check-ac04-only.test.ts:6-17 authors rejection fixtures for tool, asset, mapped, and package inputs; lines 18-27 preserve historical documentation and mathematical relay vocabulary.
priorFindingRechecks.assessment: The checker now covers the relevant package inputs, mappings, assets, and executable tools without treating generic retained GrainSilo/RelayMast geometry or historical evidence as active campaign content. Test and historical-document exclusions are visible and bounded. No practical security bypass or material false-positive defect was found in the reviewed scope.

priorFindingRechecks.status: partially closed by production seam and authored native fixtures; full integration gap remains
evidence: src/server/AC04Persistence.ts:6-13 provides the production IO seam used directly by AC04CampaignService, rather than a test-only duplicate.

src/tests/AC04Persistence.spec.ts authors coverage for malformed load refusal, retry, changed malformed transform input, dirty revision across an in-flight write, completion during write, closing drain, bounded retries, player isolation, an actual BindableEvent-yielded store, capture/removal ordering, and settlement ordering through save/report/teardown/release.
src/tests/AC04Startup.spec.ts authors a production-service startup fixture that checks unpublished Studio initialization without eager DataStore acquisition.

The new fixtures do not exercise the full real RemoteFunction/RemoteEvent path or a complete CombatService StartMission -> Loading/Ready -> authoritative win -> persistence -> result -> teardown flow.
priorFindingRechecks.assessment: The most important persistence coordinator behavior now has direct authored coverage, but these tests were not executed in this review and the full live service boundary remains a documented coverage gap. Pure and seam fixtures must not be represented as live gameplay or published DataStore proof.

evidence: src/server/AC04Completion.ts:7-22 validates the authoritative result, consumes state.active exactly once, and records a valid win synchronously before any persistence operation can yield.
src/server/AC04CampaignService.ts:100-108 performs that synchronous capture and returns the persistence/result-notification closure instead of scheduling it internally.
src/server/CombatService.ts:528-539 captures through OnFinished synchronously during settlement scheduling, then invokes the returned closure from the protected settlement save hook.
src/shared/SessionGuard.ts:124-132 runs save before teardown/release and protects failures; src/server/CombatService.ts:546-550 performs teardown and admission release only afterward.
src/server/CombatService.ts:1513-1515 also refuses admission while the player is completing, while the session remains registered until protected settlement releases it.
priorFindingRechecks.assessment: The earlier removal race and the parent-caught teardown-before-save regression are both closed by the current ownership/order. The source order is capture -> deferred protected save/report -> teardown -> release.

parentReviewFollowup.completionCallback: OnFinished captures synchronously and returns the cloud/report closure. CombatService invokes that closure in Settlement.save before cleanupSession and completing.delete.
parentReviewFollowup.returnToMenu: src/server/AC04CampaignService.ts:58-67 rejects a finished session, saves dirty cloud progress before EndMission, then rechecks closing/player/state identity and finished status after the yielding save before teardown. Campaign requests remain serialized by state.busy, so a second normal campaign launch cannot replace the session during that yield.
parentReviewFollowup.remainingRaceAssessment: No deterministic remaining race was found. PlayerRemoving registration and completion interleavings retain the captured dirty revision for drain; bounded shutdown and external DataStore failure can still prevent durability, which is an operational limit rather than a source ordering guarantee.

productionWiring.freshStore: src/server/AC04CampaignService.ts:24-26 lazily opens only SkybreakAC04Fresh_20261027_v1; lines 39-40 use player_${UserId} keys.
productionWiring.serviceChain: src/server/index.server.ts:51-52 wires CombatService's FinishedCallback to AC04CampaignService.OnFinished, then initializes the campaign service with the real CombatService API.
productionWiring.shutdown: src/server/AC04CampaignService.ts:115-123 marks states closing, drains before deletion on PlayerRemoving, and performs bounded parallel drains during BindToClose.
productionWiring.singleSortie: src/server/CombatService.ts:1515 deliberately retains the one-sortie shared-Terrain gate. This review does not request multiplayer changes; maxPlayers=1 remains a pending release setting rather than source/cloud proof.

remainingCoverageAndOperationalLimits.gap: The authored AC04Progress, AC04Persistence, AC04Startup, BindableEvent-yield, and settlement-order tests have not yet been executed in the Roblox engine for this fix revision.
remainingCoverageAndOperationalLimits.impact: The earlier 455/456 engine passes predate these fixes. TypeScript and five checker fixtures passing establish only their stated scope.
remainingCoverageAndOperationalLimits.minimalNextEvidence: After the active Studio/live-playtest lease ends, run the normal unfiltered bun run test:roblox and the repository validation gate on the same revision, recording exact pass/fail counts and SHA.

remainingCoverageAndOperationalLimits.gap: There is still no full real-service fixture covering RemoteFunction StartMission, Loading/Ready, an authoritative CombatService win, OnFinished capture, a yielding save, MissionState result delivery, teardown, and a subsequent admission.
remainingCoverageAndOperationalLimits.impact: The pure/seam settlement fixture verifies the intended order but cannot prove every production remote and world-lifecycle connection is correct.
remainingCoverageAndOperationalLimits.minimalNextEvidence: Add one bounded Roblox integration fixture using the real AC04CampaignService and CombatService boundary, or cover the same chain in the owned live playtest. Do not describe the existing pure fixture as that proof.

remainingCoverageAndOperationalLimits.gap: Published fresh-store save/rejoin, concurrent-server UpdateAsync behavior, throttling/failure recovery, and the platform shutdown deadline remain unverified.
remainingCoverageAndOperationalLimits.impact: A 20/23-second bounded drain with three write attempts cannot guarantee durability during sustained service failure or an operation that outlives shutdown.
remainingCoverageAndOperationalLimits.minimalNextEvidence: Verify save/rejoin and controlled failure behavior in the published fresh namespace after release coordination; record failures honestly rather than promising guaranteed durability.

remainingCoverageAndOperationalLimits.gap: Physical deletion of SkybreakCampaign_v1 and SkybreakAC04Campaign_v1 remains pending coordinated cutover with the required private Open Cloud credential.
remainingCoverageAndOperationalLimits.impact: The fresh epoch prevents reads/migration but is not evidence that old cloud records were deleted; old published servers could recreate records before cutover.
remainingCoverageAndOperationalLimits.minimalNextEvidence: Perform and record the authorized deletion only during the coordinated release cutover after old servers can no longer recreate those keys.

finalAssessment: No actual defect remains identified by this source recheck. The persistence guard, transform refusal, dirty-revision preservation, synchronous completion capture, protected save-before-teardown ordering, ReturnToMenu save ordering, production service wiring, and expanded AC04-only checker are internally consistent at the reviewed hashes. Runtime execution, full real-service integration, published cloud behavior, maxPlayers release configuration, and legacy cloud deletion remain explicitly unverified or pending.
